changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: period_flow is a regular VIEW, so it always reflects the current data: a closed period reads its recorded result and an open one sums what was paid by wallet, the invoice payments included.
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW financial.period_flow AS SELECT fp.id AS id_financial_period, fp.starting_at, fp.ending_at, fp.status, COALESCE(pr.revenues, paid.revenues) AS revenues, COALESCE(pr.expenses, paid.expenses) AS expenses, COALESCE(pr.result, paid.revenues - paid.expenses) AS result, pr.id IS NOT NULL AS recorded FROM registration.financial_periods fp LEFT JOIN financial.period_results pr ON pr.id_financial_period = fp.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.value_paid) FILTER (WHERE m.type = 'INCOME'), 0) AS revenues, COALESCE(SUM(p.value_paid) FILTER (WHERE m.type = 'EXPENSE'), 0) AS expenses FROM financial.movements m JOIN financial.payments p ON p.id_movement = m.id WHERE m.id_financial_period = fp.id AND p.method = 'WALLET' AND pr.id IS NULL ) paid;
